sections.position: Executive Personal Branding on LinkedIn @ SamanthakellyMedia
sections.bio: I work with founders, executives and business leaders who want to build a strong presence, grow their network and attract the right opportunities.Known globally as a super-connector, I believe relationships are everything"I don't want people to think I'm bragging. I never know what to say". (If you are adding value and inspiring others, it's not bragging)I help experts shine online—authentically, confidently, and with purpose.Through my trusted relationships with decision-makers, I’m able to introduce my clients to the right people — helping them avoid hours of cold outreach and start meaningful conversations sooner.Examples: Sarah had a 15% uplift in sales after working with me.Anita achieved 10k in sales from 2 useful introductions I made. 1 useful introduction led to one client winning 6k worth of business.One of my clients has a speaking moment for a major event (and is getting paid to speak).Co-hosted a webinar for a client which had over 80 attendees. 15 booked calls.Following a linkedIn live interview, my client sold tickets for her upcoming event.A client who is part of the leadership team at a successful company, spoke at an event in front of 150 attendees, which she wouldn't have done if I hadn't organised it for her.  This resulted in her having more confidence to do more and built trust with the audience and valuable relationships which hadn't been built beforehand.I will be your guide. Ask about my 6 week program or LinkedIn retainer.

posts.text:
Good morning everyone! I have listened to your feedback and am hosting a masterclass in LinkedIn newsletters and events. 
September is a time of networking, events and making sure you stand out from your competitors. So join us and learn how these powerful tools can help you improve your presence, engagement and sales. And you will also get to hang out with me! 😊 
https://lnkd.in/dgugePcs

Get rid of what's holding you back from success. For me it was alcohol. (18 years of sobriety now). But for others it can be a person, a place or a thing. 
Fear, lack of confidence, the wrong mentor or coach, the wrong people in your circle.

Experience helps you make better decisions. Change of miindset and situations helps a lot.

What holds you back from posting or adding value? Is it fear of what people will think? Remember it only matters if your ideal client or community likes it and it resonates.

What's stopping you from hiring someone to guide you? Were you stung before? Did they not deliver on their promises? I am so sorry you had that experience. Invest in someone who cares and walks the walk. 

Make sure you are hiring someone who cares. If it's someone to help you stand out make sure THEY stand out. 
Make sure they help others 
Do they highlight others?
Do they give value or are all of their tips from AI?
Do they have recommendations? 

Ask people you trust. If you are unsure of who is the best person to hire for something feel free to ask me. Investing in a service is not a gamble it's to get results.
Hire someone with Integrity and who has the social proof. 

What's holding you back? Let's get you noticed. It's your turn now 😊

Why use LinkedIn newsletters?
Create an engaged community around your brand.
Stay top of mind.
Build more connections and leads.
Show you are the expert in your niche
Build trust.
Attract more leads and sales. Also, LinkedIn events are extremely powerful for lead generation and you can invite people in bulk according to industry, location etc. 
Join me on September 23rd for my virtual masterclass on LInkedIn newsletters and events
https://lnkd.in/dgugePcs

Inspired by a lovely post from Alex Reilley about his first ever customer. I remember mine too. It was an online sale and it was a man and I was surprised because the product was a first period gift box for young teens. (My first business).
It turned out my best customers were separated and lone fathers! Made sense later. 
The little 'ping' when an order came in 😊
Do you remember your first customer?

You are the expert in your industry. Let's make sure you stand out from your competitors! 
Optimise your LinkedIn, make useful introductions, content ideas & more. 
Book now ⏬️
https://lnkd.in/g8tu3iZV

sections.title: Why work with me
sections.body:
Authenticity and kindness, helping others to see possibilities and encouraging entrepreneurship, connecting and community is what I'm all about. 
Business owners follow me mostly so B2B content is what I'm known for. Standing out online, especially LinkedIn. I also host LinkedIn lives and have a highly engaged  community. Passionate about adding value, helping business owners overcome the fear of what others will think, sharing knowledge and being authentic
